instruction: I have drafted my resignation email on Gmail. Attach "~/documents/work/resignation_letter.pdf" from my file system to it and schedule it to be sent to my manager on next to next Tuesday at 10 am.
notes: Current datetime 2023-05-20 is a Saturday: next Tuesday is 2023-05-23, so 'next to next Tuesday at 10 am' is 2023-05-30T10:00:00 (phone.get_current_date_and_time is modeled as the lookup that establishes the date). The manager is identified via phone.search_contacts with relationship='manager' (phone login uses the phone number as username; gmail and file_system use the email). The draft is located with gmail.show_drafts(query='resignation'); the attachment is uploaded with gmail.upload_attachments_to_draft using both the gmail and file_system tokens, and gmail.update_draft sets email_addresses=[manager email] and scheduled_send_at without touching subject/body (eval requires only recipient and schedule changes on the one draft plus one new attachment). supervisor.complete_task takes no API arguments (no answer); its non-API record parameters are bound through static target-* facts so its precondition equals the task goal.
